description_en: Modifies a traffic throttling rule in a quality of service (QoS) policy
description_zh: 调用ModifyQosCar接口修改QoS限速规则
kebab_example: aliyun smartag modify-qos-car --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --qos-id qos-awfxl1adxeqyk0000 --qos-car-id qoscar-n5k8g97lihlph0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyQosCar

parameters.help_en: The description of the traffic throttling rule
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region to which the QoS policy belongs
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the QoS policy
parameters.name: qos_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the traffic throttling rule
parameters.name: qos_car_id

parameters.help_en: The priority value of the traffic throttling rule. A smaller value specifies a higher priority. If multiple rules have the same priority, the rule that is applied first takes effect. Valid values: 1 to 7
parameters.help_zh: 设置限速规则的优先级，数值越小，优先级越高，同优先级时先下发的规则优先生效。 优先级范围：1~7
parameters.name: priority

parameters.help_en:
The type of the traffic throttling rule. Valid values:

Absolute: throttles traffic based on a specific range of bandwidth.
Percent: throttles traffic based on a specific range of bandwidth percentage
parameters.help_zh:
限速类型，取值：

Absolute：按带宽值。

Percent：按百分比
parameters.name: limit_type

parameters.help_en:
The minimum bandwidth value. The value must be an integer. Unit: Mbit/s.

This parameter is required when you set LimitType to Absolute
parameters.help_zh:
最小带宽，带宽值需要输入整数，单位：Mbps。

LimitType是Absolute时必填
parameters.name: min_bandwidth_abs

parameters.help_en:
The maximum bandwidth value. The value must be an integer. Unit: Mbit /s.

This parameter is required when you set LimitType to Absolute.

The maximum bandwidth value must be greater than the minimum bandwidth value
parameters.help_zh:
最大带宽，带宽值需要输入整数，单位：Mbps。

LimitType是Absolute时必填。

输入的最大带宽值必须大于最小带宽值
parameters.name: max_bandwidth_abs

parameters.help_en:
The minimum bandwidth percentage. Unit: percent (%). Valid values: 1 to 100.

This parameter is required when you set LimitType to Percent
parameters.help_zh:
最小带宽百分比，单位：百分比（%），取值范围：1~100。

LimitType是Percent时必填
parameters.name: min_bandwidth_percent

parameters.help_en:
The maximum bandwidth percentage. Unit: percent (%). Valid values: 1 to 100.

This parameter is required when you set LimitType to Percent.

The maximum bandwidth percentage must be greater than the minimum bandwidth percentage
parameters.help_zh:
最大带宽百分比，单位：百分比（%），取值范围：1~100。

LimitType是Percent时必填。

输入的最大带宽百分比必须大于最小带宽百分比
parameters.name: max_bandwidth_percent

parameters.help_en:
The type of bandwidth when traffic is throttled based on bandwidth percentage. Valid values:

CcnBandwidth: Cloud Connect Network (CCN) bandwidth
InternetUpBandwidth: total Internet bandwidth
parameters.help_zh:
百分比限速时的带宽类型，取值：

CcnBandwidth：表示CCN带宽。

InternetUpBandwidth：表示Internet总带宽
parameters.name: percent_source_type

parameters.help_en:
The name of the traffic throttling rule.

The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). The name must start with a letter
parameters.help_zh:
QoS限速规则名称。

长度为2~128，以字母或中文开头，且只包含中文、字母、数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）
parameters.name: name
